name: com.eddy.debuglibrary.presentation.view.ui.permission.PermissionActivity
description: The visibledebugtool library by snaps-eddy opens this Activity when its floating log viewer needs permission to appear over other apps. Its prompt can take the user to Android's overlay permission settings.
disableEffect: The tool cannot guide the user to grant overlay access, so its log viewer may remain unavailable until that permission is enabled in system settings.
